design.name: 雷鼓夔
design.brief: The Kui (夔) of the Shan Hai Jing, 'like an ox, grey-blue, hornless... with ONE SINGLE LEG', whose hide made the thunder drum heard for five hundred li: a stout grey-blue ox beast with a huge round belly stretched like a drum skin with painted thunder spirals, standing on EXACTLY ONE thick leg placed in the middle under its body, ending in one big hoof, like a pogo stick: it has NO second leg anywhere, no hind legs, no pair of legs; two short stubby forelimbs (arms) on its chest with hoof-like fists, small horns, frost and ice crystals on its back. It hops on its single leg and beats its own belly to launch hail; the drum belly glows pale jade-green when charged (weak spot). Gruff and booming.
design.weapon: mid-hop on its single leg, both stubby forelimbs drumming on its glowing belly, hailstones bursting out
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps. Count the legs: in EVERY view there is exactly one leg under the body.
